uva_cds.title: UVA Common Data Set 2025-2026 (C13 application fee)

test_policy.notes: Fall 2027 first-years choose whether to share SAT/ACT scores; no disadvantage either way. UVA superscores. Scores are self-reported, official reports required only on enrollment.

requirements.notes: Fee from the 2025-26 Common Data Set ($75, waivable for need). Requires the secondary school report plus one academic teacher evaluation; counselor letter itself can be replaced by another administrator or teacher letter. Only interview offered: optional InitialView or Vericant evaluation (same deadlines as the application). Demonstrated interest not tracked. Applicants apply to one of: College of Arts & Sciences, Architecture, Engineering, Nursing, Kinesiology; McIntire, Batten and Data Science applicants apply to the College.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' this date. Teacher/counselor documents due Nov 8. Deposit expected by Jan 15, 2027.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' this date. Teacher/counselor documents due Nov 8.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' this date. Teacher/counselor documents due Jan 10.

english_policy.waiver_notes: UVA strongly encourages all applicants whose first language is not English to take an English assessment regardless of schooling; no minimum scores are published. Accepted: TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency, Duolingo English Test.

english.notes: C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency; no minimum published

aid.notes: UVA states it has no funds for scholarships or loans for international students who are foreign nationals, and does not recommend applying without means to pay; admitted students must submit a Financial Guarantee. Exception: graduates of United World College schools qualify for need-based scholarship support (Davis Foundation Scholarship).

sat.note: UVA's page gives only 'Our ETS code is 5820' under score reporting (SAT/ACT/AP/IB are self-reported at application; official scores needed only on enrollment).

toefl.note: Page labels 5820 as UVA's ETS code (TOEFL is an ETS test). English tests are encouraged, not required.

tier_notes.business: McIntire School of Commerce is a top-10 undergraduate business program.
tier_notes.nursing: School of Nursing is a top-15 undergraduate nursing program.
tier_notes.engineering: Engineering is solid but ranked outside the top 40.
